description: This file contains the implementation of stock ledger operations in ERPNext, including stock entry processing, rate calculations, stock reconciliation, and handling of serial numbers and batch stocks.

classes.name: NegativeStockError
classes.description: Custom exception for negative stock validation errors.

classes.name: SerialNoExistsInFutureTransaction
classes.description: Exception raised when serial number is used in future transactions.

classes.name: update_entries_after
classes.description: Class to update valuation rate and quantity after a stock transaction, from the current time-bucket onwards.

methods.name: make_sl_entries
methods.description: Creates stock ledger entries, handles cancellation, and updates stock quantities and rates.

methods.name: repost_current_voucher
methods.description: Reposts stock ledger entries for the current voucher, updating valuation and stock quantities.

methods.name: validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates serial numbers to prevent usage in future transactions.

methods.name: validate_cancellation
methods.description: Validates if a transaction can be canceled based on reposting status.

methods.name: set_as_cancel
methods.description: Marks stock ledger entries as canceled.

methods.name: make_entry
methods.description: Creates and submits a stock ledger entry document.

methods.name: repost_future_sle
methods.description: Reposts stock ledger entries for a given voucher, updating related stock data.

methods.name: get_args_for_future_sle
methods.description: Prepares arguments for fetching future stock ledger entries.

methods.name: update_qty_in_future_sle
methods.description: Updates quantity after transaction in future stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_previous_sle_of_current_voucher
methods.description: Fetches the previous stock ledger entry before the current voucher.

methods.name: get_previous_sle
methods.description: Fetches the last stock ledger entry on or before a given date/time.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Retrieves stock ledger entries filtered by posting date/time conditions.

methods.name: get_sle_by_voucher_detail_no
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entry by voucher detail number.

methods.name: get_valuation_rate
methods.description: Calculates the valuation rate for an item based on recent stock ledger entries or item data.

methods.name: get_stock_reco_qty_shift
methods.description: Calculates quantity shift caused by stock reconciliation.

methods.name: get_next_stock_reco
methods.description: Fetches the next stock reconciliation entry after a given date/time.

methods.name: get_datetime_limit_condition
methods.description: Generates SQL condition for date/time limit based on stock reconciliation details.

methods.name: validate_negative_qty_in_future_sle
methods.description: Validates if future stock ledger entries would result in negative stock.

methods.name: get_future_sle_with_negative_qty
methods.description: Fetches future stock ledger entry with negative quantity.

methods.name: get_future_sle_with_negative_batch_qty
methods.description: Fetches future stock ledger entry with negative batch quantity.

methods.name: _round_off_if_near_zero
methods.description: Rounds a number to zero if it is very close to zero within specified precision.
